## FDP y FDA: Distribución Uniforme con $a=1$ y $b=4$
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-align: center
#| warning: false

par(
  mfrow = c(1,2),
  mar = c(5,5,3,1),
  bg = "white",
  family = "sans"
)

# Parámetros
a <- 1
b <- 4

# Colores
col_fdp <- "#2e7d32"
col_fda <- "#b23a48"

# =========================
# FDP Uniforme
# =========================
curve(
  dunif(x, a, b),
  from = 0,
  to = 5,
  lwd = 4,
  col = col_fdp,
  ylim = c(0,0.42),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = "Función de densidad U(1,4)",
  cex.main = 1.5,
  cex.lab = 1.3,
  cex.axis = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray85")

# Líneas verticales del soporte
abline(v = c(a,b), lty = 2, lwd = 2, col = "gray45")

# Área sombreada
polygon(
  c(a, a, b, b),
  c(0, 1/(b-a), 1/(b-a), 0),
  col = adjustcolor(col_fdp, alpha.f = 0.20),
  border = NA
)

text(
  2.5, 0.37,
  labels = "Densidad constante",
  cex = 1.1
)

# =========================
# FDA Uniforme
# =========================
curve(
  punif(x, a, b),
  from = 0,
  to = 5,
  lwd = 4,
  col = col_fda,
  ylim = c(0,1.05),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "F(x)",
  main = "Función acumulada U(1,4)",
  cex.main = 1.5,
  cex.lab = 1.3,
  cex.axis = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray85")

abline(v = c(a,b), lty = 2, lwd = 2, col = "gray45")
abline(h = c(0,1), lty = 3, col = "gray60")

points(c(a,b), c(0,1), pch = 19, cex = 1.3, col = col_fda)

text(
  2.7, 0.55,
  labels = "Incremento lineal",
  cex = 1.1
)
```
